method.background: Use two held AIR measured head-rig impulse-response sets from lecture and meeting rooms and two AMI meetings with no participant from earlier WPE or directional work. Reuse each six-second background, gain and room across versions. Require at least 320 ms of overlapping annotated background speakers in both edit destinations for host groups. Use 0 and −5 dB stereo mean target/background SNR and add background-only controls.
method.comparison: Keep native mono at 5.356589748054317. Compare WPE at this same operating point, at the earlier eight-reader point 7.353627562469017, and at cutoffs allowing zero, one or two added genuine development groups. Apply all fixed points to new held scores. Count exact localized edit and ordinary reader groups, with file-condition rescues separate from pooled unique groups. A correct timestamp covers at least half the authored edit at interval IoU of at least .30.
method.foreground: Select two new held host readers and two different publisher synthesis families per host. Prefer within-source-reader donor families for the first host, and use a separate new donor-only reader pool for the second host. Use native intervals of the already published partial recordings, without generating new speech. Each ordinary control uses a different fragment of its own host. Apply identical 20 ms fades and the same two 960 ms destinations for ordinary and synthetic variants. All dry versions exactly match outside the selected interval.
method.roles: Choose up to four distinct development-only genuine reader groups for additive WPE operating points while reserving at least two separate genuine assessment readers. Every fit reader contributes matched ordinary and untouched variants. Hold the two matched reader groups and six isolated background excerpts. No scored assessment variant may enter point fitting.
